investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimbari (online marketplace); Platform: AWS eu-west-1, Kubernetes cluster nm-prod-euw1 (EKS, node range 10.120.0.0/16, nodes provisioned by Karpenter); search-api pods run with 4 GiB memory limits; Deployments: Argo Rollouts canary releases with automated analysis (CHG- identifiers).
